segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the scope for the renewal before I send it through deal desk. I have you at 42 seats today, moving to 55 seats on the team plan starting September 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We added the support managers and two analysts, so 55 is the number. We don't need the advanced reporting add-on for all of them, just the 12 managers.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 55 core seats and 12 advanced reporting seats. The pricing sheet puts that at $68,400 for the 12-month term, before tax. Same payment terms as last year, net 30, annual invoice?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, annual invoice is fine. Can you make sure the invoice references PO 44718? Our AP team kicked it back last time because the PO wasn't on the first page.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I'll add PO 44718 to the order form and billing notes. On timing, if we get signature by August 20, the billing tool will generate the invoice on August 22, and the new seats will be active September 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. One thing, legal asked if the auto-renewal language is the same as the current agreement. They don't want a new review if nothing changed.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No changes there. It's the same 12-month renewal term with 60 days' notice for non-renewal. I'll point that out in the email and attach the current terms for reference.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Also, can you list the implementation contact as Marcus Lee instead of me? He'll handle the user upload.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. I'll put Marcus Lee as the technical contact, keep you as the billing contact, and send the order form by end of day. If anything looks off, just reply and I'll fix it before it goes to signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it over, and I should be able to turn it around tomorrow.
